checks.note: Proposition says the trial 'produced' $8.3M a month. The contract treats this as a run-rate conversion of >$100M annualized, not receipts. 'Well short of... low billions in 2026' implies a missed target, which the contract excludes. It also drops the annualized basis. Excerpt stops mid-sentence and omits the 'low billions... according to the Financial Times' part that the proposition and from_speaker criteria rely on. Rationale, citations and outcome otherwise fine.
